links.outcome: ChatGPT accuracy on clinical vignette tasks across differential diagnosis, testing, final diagnosis, management
links.effect: Overall accuracy 71.7% (95% CI 69.3%-74.1%); final diagnosis 76.9%; initial differential diagnosis 60.3% (95% CI 54.2%-66.6%).
links.quote: ChatGPT achieved an overall accuracy of 71.7% (95% CI 69.3%-74.1%) across all 36 clinical vignettes.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's diagnostic and management accuracy across 36 published clinical vignettes from the MSD Manual; does not evaluate an organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
